content: The results of the pseudo-perplexity described in the previous section to evaluate the above models on the test data-set is in table (Table TABREF12).The test dataset is of a different context when compared to the training data, and interestingly both the models are quite confident when it comes to the test dataset. The pseudo-perplexity values of left-marked are lower when compared to left-right-marked signifying that it is more confident.
